$comment: VR2-00 route/state fixture manifest. Every VR2 ticket names ONE ordinary product runtime route, its state(s), and the approved VO-T1 board target article(s) it is compared against. A design-system specimen (Grundlagen/Foundations, Gallery, registry), Storybook, a unit test surface, or a deep-only / hidden prototype route is NOT an accepted consumer and is listed under `specimenRoutes` so the evidence gate can reject it. `targets` are stable anchors that resolve to the approved board's `id="target-<id>"` articles (the board renders them from the target data ids: opportunities, project, workspace, building, config-long, config-short, comparison, present-identity, present-scope, present-commercial, present-timeline, present-options, present-next, offer, send-review, send-delivered, surfaces). Viewports and locales are the standing gate requirement, enforced per-locale (each required locale must carry BOTH required viewports); reducedMotion:true is additionally required where the ticket owns motion. Routes are logical names for the state-driven app (there is no path router); `entry` records the ordinary way a user reaches the state from a cold portfolio.
